V8_walls_raycast.method: inward ray from area-weighted surface samples (trimesh/embree), thickness = first exit; every thin structural sample is re-checked in the XY slice at its height (ThinMap): 'wall' = strip >= 2 mm long thinner than 1.2 (fail), 'corner' = acute-corner tip / short stub (warn), 'edge_z_only' = XY section >= 1.2 wide there (stepped edge round seen by a vertical ray, warn)

rib_back.note: rays at clipped / rounded rib ends; rib body width checked in V8_ribs

rib_band.note: rays at clipped / rounded rib ends; rib body width checked in V8_ribs

rib_front.note: rays at clipped / rounded rib ends; rib body width checked in V8_ribs

rib_groove.note: rays at clipped / rounded rib ends; rib body width checked in V8_ribs

V8_walls_layers.method: per layer mid-height: pieces of slice - opening(slice, 1.2) (>= 0.02 mm^2), classified 'wall' (strip >= 2 mm long) or 'corner' (acute-corner tip / stub); w_est = local width estimate

V8_back_plate.note: only the skin's cosmetic plate deboss (e.g. stitch groove) is thinner

V8_roof.criterion: >= 2.0 (vertical, over the head channels; interior = off the r 1.0 top-edge round and the keep-out cone)
V8_roof.note: thinner only within the r 1.0 top-edge round of the body outline and where the 45 deg umbrella keep-out trims the roof's inner edge (r 17.1-17.4 about O): edge geometry

V8_fingers.criterion: >= 4.29 (chord perpendicular to the finger axis, pallet centre -> root)

V8_legs.criterion: >= 7.0 (chord perpendicular to A->B where the leg is not under the face)
V8_legs.note: narrowed near the pallet end A by WheelEx2D = SweptInv(disc(O, 14.90)) - the SPEC's own HeadBand2D definition; the narrowed section sees less bending than the full-width root

V8_slivers_2d.criterion: no sliver (strip >= 2 mm long) narrower than 1.6 in Fill2D (pads excluded) / Roof2D

V8_stop_pads.criterion: pads are <= 0.6 thick by construction ([Rot(Leg) (+) 0.55] - Swept(HB)); every part must be backed by the fill wall (no free fin > 0.8 long)

V8_ribs.criterion: rib pieces reach the designed width 0.8

V8_slivers_frame_layers.criterion: frame layers z 2.6-10.4: no sliver (strip >= 2 mm long) narrower than 1.6 (stop pads and posts excluded)

V9_overhangs.criterion: faces > 45.0 deg from vertical (+0.5 deg tol) must be bed, listed bridge (roof <= 13.5, umbrella plate <= 10.5, bores D 8.7), listed rib float (pitch <= 4.5, gap 0.40) or chamfer micro-step <= 0.3
